title: Time
comment: Add t, and the picture starts to move: the shape of last week turned by t over
a four-second video; a sine of t that breathes and loops without a seam; a
timeline of the two with a glitch and a fade between them, looped. The
demonstration's cuts are real cuts of this Reel (sub-cuts of its timeline), so
the glitch tears the whole page as it would the video.
draws: let r_film = (tl < 2) * rotate(s, tl / 2 * 360) + (tl >= 2) * zoom(s, 1 + sin((tl - 2) / 2 * tau) / 2)

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: time
sections.say: Add t, and the picture starts to move.
stage: let hk1 = text("05  ·  time", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: t: the shape turned by t, a 4-second video
sections.label: t
sections.say: t runs from zero to one. Turn the shape by t.

sections.name: a loop: a sine of t breathes, no seam
sections.label: a loop
sections.say: A sine of t breathes, and the loop has no seam.

sections.name: a timeline: scenes, a glitch between them, a loop
sections.label: a timeline
sections.say: A timeline: scenes, and a glitch between them. Loop it.

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: filters. Blur, pixels, edges, film grain. One word each.

let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 1.15, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 49.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  06  ·  filters", x: 0.5, y: 1.26, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l5.words[2])
